_readme: The arrival seen from the beach face (scenes/demos/impact_shore_near.json; 2026-10-28, Mark: 'the waves seen from the shore are obvious and they should wash over the land'): the eye over the foreshore south of the north jetty looking to sea, held through the bore's arrival (the 9 km point rises at 0:05 of the clip, the beach at 0:13, the jetty's +8 m at 0:17), then up over the dune as the island overwashes, and higher for the drawdown (the 7 m trough at 0:38) and the second crest. 60 s at 30 fps = 30 min at the scene's 60x, one sim second a frame. The first rail (impact_shore.json) stood behind the dune in the marsh at -70.8075, where the sea was a strip at the horizon and the arrival read as the marsh flooding; -70.801 was still the flats behind the dune (the water rose about the eye at 0:14), so the eye stands at -70.792, on the beach face or just off it.
name: impact_shore_face
